## AuthError class

Base Authentication Error Class

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class AuthError extends CustomError<AuthErrorCodesType> 
```
**Extends:** CustomError&lt;[AuthErrorCodesType](./auth-errors.autherrorcodestype.md)<!-- -->&gt;

## Remarks

Extends the framework's CustomError class to provide typed authentication errors. This serves as the foundation for all authentication-related errors in the system.

## Example


```typescript
throw new AuthError({
  code: 'INCORRECT_CREDENTIALS',
  name: 'AuthError',
  logLevel: 'warn',
  message: 'Invalid email or password'
});
```
